summary: The test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly, with async assertions awaited properly. The test case ID is preserved in the test title. However, the selector '[data-test="product-1"]' may be too specific or fragile depending on the UI and could cause maintenance issues if product IDs change. The URL assertion using a regex /product/ is weak and might pass even if the wrong product detail is loaded, lacking specificity to confirm the correct product detail page is displayed.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is very specific to a particular product and may not be reusable if product data changes.
issues.recommendation: Consider using more stable or parameterized selectors or abstractions to improve reusability and maintainability.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a generic regex /product/ which may not sufficiently ensure the correct product detail page is displayed.
issues.recommendation: Use more specific URL matching or include assertions verifying that key product detail elements are present on the page.

recommendations: Enhance URL assertions to confirm precise navigation to the intended product detail page.
Add assertions verifying the presence of critical product information on the product detail page to strengthen test coverage.
Consider abstracting selectors or parameterizing them to improve test resilience to UI changes.
